notes: Same rule set as Sunmeadow v2 (R1-R10); region-specific values only. R5_bluff_margin_m applies to every relief collider in the layout (rectangle and polygon footprints and the toe lines marked path_clearance_m: cliffs, basalt rims, ruin walls, the pressure ridge, the barred gate).

R6 apron = the arrival hollow: a 50 x 50 m box centred on the windstone_arrival dais. No homes, no leash polygons and no aggro disc inside it (the producer brief: no spawns or aggro within 25 m of the arrival).

R6 quest objects (checker_profile.quest_object_pois): the three fishing holes (lv1), wind runes (lv2) and ward braziers (lv3). An aggressive monster keeps its aggro disc 2 m short of each, so a player can always reach the object after pulling.

R7 (edge-based): every road_safe road (arrival, lakeshore, ridge, return, emberpass) is never inside an aggro disc. The rimehold_way, the cave spur and the hidden causeway are road_safe false: the danger routes into the ruin, the grotto and the isle (H2 still applies).

R5 boss: the Solar Scorpion's home and patrol stay on the layout sunscald_dais (r 3) and its body (r 2.4) stays 0.5 m inside the 12 m arena. Regular homes stay 14.5 m from the arena centre and every regular leash polygon 2 m outside the arena (R9_ring_clear_m).
R9 sanctuary: the lv1 zones (clearing glassmere_shore) keep their leash polygons 1 m off the lakeshore and arrival road surfaces.
R10: 38 rows in one world (Rimecrest is its own zone instance), well under the 64-monster snapshot cap until AOI (A32 lands in week 3).

telegraph_language.base: as Sunmeadow v2 (docs/reviews/2026-10-01-vfx-brief-for-codex.md): dark outer rim, bright band, soft inner glow; shape + timer + sound + body cue, never colour alone
snow_notes: on snow and ice (value 0.70-0.85) the dark outer rim carries the read; the ice shelf stays below 0.8 luma
the arena floor is dark wet basalt (0.25-0.35): the crimson band and the bright glow read; the dark rim is lifted by a 1 px glow
steam inside the arena stays under 20 % opacity below 2 m; decals draw above the steam cards

roster.role: Rimecrest field boss (MVP). A sun-forged guardian sleeping under the Sunscald basin: its solar core never cooled, so hot springs and geysers melt the snow around it. The Rime-wardens raised their temple to keep it asleep; the wards are failing. It rises on the sun-dais when the sun is high. Capstone for L20-23 groups of 3-6; Galehorn's counterpart (Galehorn wakes at dusk, the Scorpion at noon).

hp.note: u16 on the wire today; re-tune to about 90,000 after the u32 widening (decision 12)

stats.exp_rule: split by contribution; MVP +25 % of base EXP (decision 7)

aggro.mode: passive until provoked, then aggressive to every player inside the arena
aggro.spawn_gate: daylight >= 0.5 (day) and the respawn window elapsed
aggro.announce: zone message 60 s before: 'The ice groans over Sunscald... the buried sun is waking.' (Thai/English) + every geyser bursts at once and the steam turns gold; on spawn the nest is named; on defeat the zone hears the MVP name
aggro.tombstone: at the dais after death: MVP name + the respawn window (decision 7)

step0.why: needs S2 passive/provoked, S3 cone/lane/donut, S4 daylight gate and S5 boss rules

step2.leash: arena circle r 12 m around the sunscald_basin centre (36,-34) (layout boss_arena_radius_m)
step2.reset: evade + full heal if no contributor is inside the arena for 10 s; contribution persists 120 s across reconnects; a reset clears contribution (A17)

skills.name: Solar Slam
skills.server_support: current splash as fallback; S3 boss ring
skills.trigger: target within 2.5 m (S3: any target within 9 m)
skills.telegraph: boss crimson ring with a carved sun-ray edge at the locked point
skills.body_cue: rears on its four hind legs, the halo blazes, both arms rise, then the forelegs slam
skills.audio_cue: rising solar hum, a ringing boom
skills.counterplay: leave the ring; its forelegs stay planted for 1.2 s (punish window, x1.5)

skills.name: Tail Sweep
skills.trigger: 2+ players in the front arc within 7 m
skills.telegraph: boss crimson cone, 120 deg, 7 m, with amber motes flowing outward
skills.body_cue: the tail coils high over the back, the amber orb flares
skills.audio_cue: a rising whine, then a whoosh
skills.counterplay: get behind or beside it; guard halves the knockback

skills.name: Sunflare Lance
skills.trigger: the farthest player in the arena
skills.telegraph: boss crimson lane 2.5 x 14 m from the tail orb
skills.body_cue: the tail orb draws light from the halo, the tail aims
skills.counterplay: leave the lane; ranged players spread

roster.phase_behaviour: Phase 2 at 60 % HP: Sunflare Lance joins the rotation and the three geysers erupt in turn every 20 s (VFX only, outside the arena). Phase 3 at 30 % HP, 'Zenith': enrage (the Enrage clip); cooldowns x0.75 and a Solar Corona donut (safe inside 4 m and outside 10 m) every 20 s.
roster.hit_reaction: Additive only: plates ring, cloth snaps, the halo flickers; heavy hits rock the torso 0.2 m. No flinch interrupts.
roster.death: The halo dims to bronze, the six legs fold, it settles onto the dais and the core's glow sinks into the vent; the basin steam turns white again; the sun-disc exit portal lights. Body stays 30 s, then the loot sparkles rise with the steam.

rune_drop.rate: 5 % in the MVP chest with pity (decision 10)

roster.loot_rule: S5: every contributor (>= 3 % damage or >= 10 s tanking/healing) gets 1 personal roll; the MVP gets +1 roll and the mvp_chest (existing item) and +25 % base EXP; tie-break: damage, then earliest first hit (decision 7)
